game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mystic Forest – Bramble Maze, a maze of brambles: the druid must handle wasp swarms while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Bramble Maze: a maze of brambles
core_gameplay_loop: In Bramble Maze, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round, a new mana petals challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of mana petals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Loop Picker
